steps.title: Open the research command center
steps.narration: The Desk page is the hub for all research workflows—corpus readiness, candidate tracking, and validation analysis. This regression test confirms the entire surface works after the backend refactoring this round.
steps.point_out: The page loads cleanly with the heading 'Desk' visible and all research sections ready to expand.

steps.title: Check corpus readiness
steps.narration: The Microscope Readiness section shows diagnostics about the research corpus—symbol-days, distinct datasets, and RTH minutes available. Expanding it verifies the readiness aggregates survived the sealed-verdict module refactoring.
steps.point_out: The section expands to show the Corpus Totals table with counts of available data.

steps.title: Review the candidate ledger
steps.narration: The Scout Ledger tracks all registered candidate strategies and their trial results. This confirms the ledger chain verification holds and the scout data remains accessible.
steps.point_out: The section expands showing the chain verification status and the ledger state, whether empty or populated with registered families.

steps.title: Inspect walk-forward validation
steps.narration: The Walk-Forward section shows the fold sequences registered for candidate testing. Each fold ensures chronological evaluation without lookahead, a core protection. This confirms the fence logic is sound.
steps.point_out: The section expands cleanly, displaying either fold specifications or an honest empty state, with no errors.

steps.title: Load the structure and resistance bands
steps.narration: The Structure page analyzes support and resistance bands for any symbol and timestamp. We navigate there to verify this core analysis surface works independent of the sealed-verdict refactoring.
steps.point_out: The page loads and displays the input fields ready for analysis.

steps.title: Watch live market data on the Cockpit
steps.narration: The Cockpit is where users see live market data in real time. This is the sentinel check that the product's core live-update pipeline still works—our kept-product regression test.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit page loads with the chart ready and the ticker input waiting. We'll type a simulated ticker and watch it update.

steps.title: Enter a simulated ticker and begin watching
steps.narration: We type a simulated ticker (SIM-BUYER) to start the live tape. The chart should render and the quote data should update in real time.
steps.point_out: The live tape activates, showing confidence, quote levels, and recent trades updating continuously.

steps.title: Click Watch to activate the feed
steps.narration: The Watch button starts the simulated feed and renders the live trading surface.
steps.point_out: Live trading data appears: the confidence level, quote levels, and a tape of recent trades all update continuously with no errors.
